evidence: Memory recall query returned 3 valid context items from project-neonpath and factory banks, all containing generic Factory operational notes about LiteLLM/vLLM validation targets. The Hindsight memory infrastructure is functional — recall succeeded and returned data. However, no project-neonpath-specific incident history exists in the memory banks, confirming the memory ingestion pipeline that compacts historical incident repairs has never been executed for this project.
attemptsReviewed: Three prior investigation runs by the Factory Investigator tool (33ecf72, 8a19876, 9d8223a, ca4c259), all correctly classified the failure as environment with high confidence. All evidence consistently shows: memory banks exist and are queryable, but lack project-neonpath-specific incident data because the memory ingestion pipeline has never backfilled historical incidents for this project.
rootCauseHypothesis: The project-neonpath Hindsight memory bank is structurally functional but not populated with historical incident summaries. The memory ingestion pipeline that compacts first-seen/resolved/reopened incident back data with linked finding/run/commit/evidence IDs has never executed for this project. Recall works correctly but returns only generic Factory operational notes stored in the default bank.
recommendedAction: Implement the Hindsight memory adapter for issue #55 first (bounded outbox, graceful offline handling, idempotency, bank isolation). The adapter must support optional recall and provide traceable provenance without asserting hypothesized causes as fact. After implementation passes verification tests, the memory ingestion pipeline can be run on-demand as an operational task to backfill historical incidents. Do not treat memory bank population as a dependency for the adapter implementation.
